finalText:
**Last night's run: 698 of 700 tests passed.** Two failed, both in `auth/tokens.test.js`.

- `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
- `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Nothing else in the log went wrong. No skips, no errors, no warnings.

Both failures sit in the same file and both touch token cleanup, so one fix may cover them.
